description: Scheduled committee hearings across committees (GET /v1/hearings), filterable by jurisdiction and start date. Use this to answer 'what is being heard this week' or to track when a committee next meets. For hearings on one specific committee use get_committee with include:['hearings']; for one specific bill use get_bill with include:['calendar'].

since.description: ISO-8601 date or timestamp; only hearings on or after it.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. FL), DC, or US for Congress.

name: list_hearings
title: List hearings
